extracted.name: Scallops with Pesto Cream Sauce
extracted.description: This delicious scallop dish only takes a few minutes to make and is to die for. Serve the scallops as they are or with some crusty bread, rice, or pasta.
ingredient_lines: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Season scallops with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat and add scallops. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes per side. Add pesto and capers; mix well. Stir in heavy cream and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and serve.
